About West Island Conservatory of Music — Pointe-Claire, Montreal

Making music magical for over 50 years

Our History

Founded over 50 years ago and located in Pointe-Claire, the West Island Conservatory of Music has a rich tradition of musical excellence serving the communities of Pointe-Claire, Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Kirkland, Beaconsfield, Pierrefonds, and Dorval. In 1997, new management under Mossor and Casny took over to modernize and sustain the institution's operations.

The conservatory maintains its reputation as one of the most elite music schools in the country, offering private lessons in piano, guitar, voice, drums, violin, and 10 other instruments.

Our Qualified Music Teachers

The conservatory employs highly qualified teachers who demonstrate excellent communication skills in teaching music and student motivation. Faculty members represent an international background, holding highly recognized university degrees in music from various countries worldwide.

Our Approach to Music Education

The institution successfully accommodates diverse students across varying age groups, goals, and musical interests. Whether you're a beginner or preparing for RCM exams, our personalized programs are designed to help you succeed.

Visit Our Pointe-Claire Studio

Located at Plaza Pointe-Claire, 269 St-Jean blvd, Suite 101. Get directions and hours or call 514-428-5080 to book your free trial lesson.
